name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI models run faster and cheaper on ordinary computer chips instead of needing expensive specialized hardware.
buyer: A hardware or embedded-software company that wants to ship AI features (vision, voice) on devices without cloud GPUs, and needs the inference to be fast on standard chips.
business_use_cases: A security-camera manufacturer runs person-detection on-device using it instead of paying for cloud inference per camera.
A retail-analytics vendor deploys in-store shelf-monitoring AI on cheap edge PCs rather than cloud servers, cutting their per-store cost.
A systems integrator offers 'optimize your AI model for edge deployment' as a paid engineering service built on the toolkit.

money_ideas.idea: Offer contract engineering services optimizing clients' AI models for edge/on-device deployment using it.
Build and sell pre-optimized model packages for common edge use cases (retail, security, manufacturing).

steal_this: This is a deep hardware-optimization toolkit for specialists, not a weekend consumer play — the real opportunity is contract work for companies already shipping edge-AI hardware.
